mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and 54 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials are reviewing several development projects this week, including the final plat for Ardent Glen and site plans at 1979 Milky Way. Also, remember that property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15.
We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and several trivia nights occurring throughout the week.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident on October 15 where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after officers received reports of dangerous driving behavior.
You can enjoy the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day at Culver's, which opens today at 10:00 AM.
